div.head: Hl 7[b]
div.ab: gif he þæt ne mæge, læte án, ⁊ fo se agend tó.
gif he þæt ne mæge, læte án, ⁊ fo se agend tó.
Gif he þæt ne mæge, læte án ⁊ fo se agend to.
wenn er das nicht kann, lasse er [es] los und greife der Eigenthümer zu.
if he cannot do that, let him let [it] go and let the owner take hold of it.
If he cannot do that, he shall surrender it, and the owner shall take possession [of it].
If he is not able [to do] that, let him relinquish [it], and the owner take possession.

note.seg: ‘give up, relax’ Toller 613 Sp. 1 letzte Z., vgl. dort onlætan. — Jedenfalls ist Strafe und wohl auch Busse hinzuzudenken, da mit Diebstahl der Satz begann
‘give up, relax’ Toller 613 col. 1 last l., cf. there onlætan. — In any case a penalty, and probably compensation too, is to be understood in addition, since the clause began with theft
